# Source-quality fixtures

These source-rendered PNGs and lossless baked captures are ground truth for the
existing source-quality regression tests. They are not demo assets and are not
included in the static site. The demo compares against its existing 32-view WebP
turntables instead.

`catalog.json` records the saved camera poses and fixture paths. Keep the images,
lossless captures and scoring baselines together; do not generate expected images
from the runtime result being tested.
